case_facts: My employer terminated me without notice or severance after I reported unsafe working conditions. I had worked there for 4 years on a permanent contract.

analysis.summary: A permanent employee of four years was terminated without notice or severance pay after reporting unsafe working conditions to the employer. The employee alleges the termination was retaliatory and procedurally defective. The dispute involves wrongful termination, whistleblower protection, and statutory entitlements.

issues.issue: Wrongful termination without notice or retrenchment compensation for a permanent employee
issues.governing_law: Industrial Disputes Act 1947, Section 25F and Section 25G
issues.kanoon_query: retrenchment without notice compensation permanent employee

issues.issue: Violation of principles of natural justice — no inquiry or show cause before dismissal
issues.kanoon_query: dismissal without inquiry natural justice industrial dispute

issues.issue: Retaliatory termination for reporting unsafe working conditions — whistleblower protection
issues.governing_law: Factories Act 1948; Whistle Blowers Protection Act 2014
issues.kanoon_query: retaliatory dismissal reporting unsafe conditions worker

issues.issue: Employer's duty to maintain safe working conditions and liability for victimisation
issues.kanoon_query: employer unsafe working conditions victimisation employee
